one_line: Founding ruler of the Kushan dynasty who united Yuezhi clans and expanded through Kabul, Gandhara, and Taxila in the 1st century CE.

appearance.age_look: Late 40s to early 50s, solid and broad-shouldered, a seasoned cavalry warlord rather than elderly.
appearance.face: Oval face with strong cheekbones, medium-tan Central Asian complexion, straight nose, trimmed moustache with short beard along the jawline, slightly hooded sharp eyes, and a calm, assessing default expression that hints at strategic confidence.
appearance.hair: Thick dark brown hair, pulled back from a short center part and gathered into a compact knot low at the back of the head, held by a simple bronze clasp; no crown, but a narrow dark red wool headband encircling the forehead just above the brows.
appearance.costume: Long-sleeved, hip-length quilted riding coat in muted deep red wool, opening slightly at the front to show an off-white linen tunic beneath; the coat is edged with narrow dark brown leather piping and faint geometric stitch patterns along the cuffs and hem. He wears straight, practical trousers in dusty olive green wool tucked into mid-calf height leather riding boots in dark brown with simple stitched bands. Over his shoulders lies a heavy, dark indigo wool cloak fastened at the right collarbone with a round bronze brooch, hanging diagonally and leaving his sword arm free. Around his waist is a broad brown leather belt with a few small bronze fittings and a hanging strap that supports his scabbard. Jewellery is minimal: a single plain bronze ring on his right hand and small rounded gold earrings close to the ear, suggesting status without ostentation.
appearance.signature: A single straight-backed cavalry sword in a plain dark brown leather scabbard with bronze fittings, worn at his left hip, its hilt wrapped in dark leather with a simple rounded bronze pommel; he often holds one of his overstruck silver coins between two fingers of his free hand as a subtle secondary prop.

ref_desc: Kujula Kadphises is a late-middle-aged, tan-complexioned warlord with a short beard, dark brown hair tied in a back knot with a red headband, wearing a deep red quilted riding coat, olive trousers, dark indigo cloak, dark brown boots, and carrying a plain cavalry sword and coin.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Kujula Kadphises: a late-middle-aged, broad-shouldered Central Asian warlord with an oval, tan-complexioned face, strong cheekbones, sharp eyes, and a trimmed moustache with short beard along the jawline, his default expression calm and strategically confident. His thick dark brown hair is pulled from a short center part into a compact knot low at the back, secured by a bronze clasp, and he wears a narrow dark red wool headband around his forehead. Dress him in a long-sleeved, hip-length deep red quilted riding coat with subtle stitched geometric patterns on cuffs and hem, opened slightly to reveal an off-white linen tunic underneath. Add straight olive green wool trousers tucked into mid-calf dark brown leather riding boots with simple stitched bands. Over his shoulders place a heavy dark indigo wool cloak fastened at the right collarbone with a round bronze brooch, hanging diagonally to leave his right arm free. Give him a broad dark brown leather belt with a few bronze fittings and a hanging strap that supports a plain dark brown leather scabbard with bronze mounts at his left hip, containing his straight-backed cavalry sword whose hilt is wrapped in dark leather with a rounded bronze pommel. Include minimal jewellery: a small gold earring on each ear and one plain bronze ring on his right hand. In one hand he lightly holds a small silver coin between two fingers as a subtle prop. Show him front, back, and a close-up of his face and sword hilt, keeping the palette to deep red, dark indigo, olive green, dark brown, and off-white, and maintain a dignified, historically grounded Kushan-era look in dynamic shonen anime style.
